mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_product WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
SELECT FROM dms_shop_product
normal_sale_enabled = 1 AND (merchant_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_merchant active_merchant WHERE active_merchant.id=dms_shop_product.merchant_id AND active_merchant.tenant_id=dms_shop_product.tenant_id AND active_merchant.status=1)) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = #{status} AND category_name = #{categoryName}
AND (product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (stock <= 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_sku sku WHERE sku.product_id=dms_shop_product.id AND sku.status=1 AND sku.stock <= 0))
AND ((stock > 0 AND stock <= safety_stock) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_sku sku WHERE sku.product_id=dms_shop_product.id AND sku.status=1 AND sku.stock > 0 AND sku.stock <= COALESCE(NULLIF(sku.safety_stock,0),dms_shop_product.safety_stock)))
AND stock > safety_stock AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_sku sku WHERE sku.product_id=dms_shop_product.id AND sku.status=1 AND sku.stock <= COALESCE(NULLIF(sku.safety_stock,0),dms_shop_product.safety_stock))
mapper.select: ORDER BY status DESC, sort_order DESC, id DESC

choose.when: ORDER BY sales_count DESC, id DESC
ORDER BY sale_price ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY sale_price DESC, id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY status DESC, sort_order DESC, id DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM dms_shop_product WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND repurchase_sale_enabled = 1 AND repurchase_price > 0 AND (merchant_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_merchant active_merchant WHERE active_merchant.id=dms_shop_product.merchant_id AND active_merchant.tenant_id=dms_shop_product.tenant_id AND active_merchant.status=1))
AND (product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sort_order DESC, id DESC

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET status = #{status}, first_publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status}=1 AND first_publish_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE first_publish_time END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET manual_new_arrival_enabled = #{enabled}, manual_new_arrival_start_time = #{startTime}, manual_new_arrival_end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE dms_shop_product SET status=0, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status<>0

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET status=0, merchant_review_status='DRAFT', merchant_review_remark=#{remark}, merchant_review_submitted_at=NULL, merchant_reviewed_at=NULL, merchant_reviewer_id=NULL, merchant_reviewer_name=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND settlement_delay_days_override IS NULL

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET status=0, merchant_review_status='PENDING', merchant_review_version=#{version}, merchant_review_remark=NULL, merchant_review_submitted_at=#{submittedAt}, merchant_reviewed_at=NULL, merchant_reviewer_id=NULL, merchant_reviewer_name=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status=0 AND merchant_review_status != 'PENDING'

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET status=#{status}, first_publish_time=CASE WHEN #{status}=1 AND first_publish_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE first_publish_time END, merchant_review_status=#{reviewStatus}, merchant_review_remark=#{remark}, merchant_reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt}, merchant_reviewer_id=#{reviewerId}, merchant_reviewer_name=#{reviewerName}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND merchant_review_version=#{version} AND merchant_review_status='PENDING'

UPDATE dms_shop_product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, sales_count = CASE WHEN sales_count >= #{quantity} THEN sales_count - #{quantity} ELSE 0 END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
